cv.name: Yasmine Larbi
cv.headline: Senior Supply Chain Analyst | Demand Planning & S&OP | Beauty and consumer goods
cv.summary: Supply chain analyst with ten years in logistics, demand planning and S&OP. Back in Paris after a two-year career break abroad, now running forecasting and S&OP analytics for a cosmetics group.

experience.title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst

Improved forecast accuracy by 9 points through new promotion uplift models
Built inventory health dashboards in Power BI for the supply and finance teams
Support the rollout of SAP IBP for demand planning

experience.title: Demand Planner / Supply Chain Analyst
bullets: Forecasting for small household appliances sold through retailers and e-commerce
Reduced obsolete stock by €1.4M with an end-of-life process

experience.title: Junior Logistics Analyst
bullets: Warehouse KPIs and transport cost analysis for retail clients

education.degree: Master in Management – Supply Chain specialisation
